## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat: Dynamic composite stream dimensions based on user preset by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/101

### Bug Fixes
* fix: Seek to liveSyncPosition before HLS playback starts by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/104
### Other Changes
* refactor: Normalize Chromecast stats and remove segments from storage/diagnostics by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/103
